information_wall.policy_input: correct task language plus current policy observation only

adapter.initialization: fresh deterministic functional identity from the frozen source base for each stage

training_recipe.physical_batch: every rank contains equal samples from all 24 tasks
training_recipe.sampling: uniform task then no-replacement episode cycles then no-replacement action-chunk cycles
training_recipe.loss_reduction: equal samples per task then ordinary batch mean
training_recipe.exact_resume: sample identity is a pure function of optimizer step, rank, task, and local task offset

data.sampling: uniform task -> uniform episode -> uniform action chunk; exact equal task counts in every physical batch

profile_contract.selection: profile B144 first; use B120 only if B144 OOMs or is unstable; choose by stable effective action queries per second
required_checks: all 24 tasks occur equally in every physical batch
loss and gradients are finite for consecutive steps
rank-128 shared LoRA is the only trainable object

observed_profile.selection: B144 completed fresh step1 and exact-resume through step3 with finite loss and gradients, all 24 tasks equally represented in every physical batch, and no OOM or allocator growth; B120 fallback was not triggered.

development.selection_data: fixed validation action-loss panel is diagnostic; complete 8-task x 50 closed-loop success selects observed-best

formal_run.budget_role: fresh corrected mixed-task ceiling search in evidence-gated one-hour segments
formal_run.selection_rule: Fresh-train from identity at B144. The measured 15.85-16.68 seconds per steady optimizer update sets the first boundary to step225, approximately one hour of training body excluding the separately reported cold model load. Retain every25-step checkpoint through the first two segments. Select by paired full validation success and cross-task breadth; exact-resume to step450 when the first-segment peak is at the right edge or materially unstable, then add later segments only while the observed-best moves right without a sustained material multi-task decline.

final.selection_data: no test outcomes; retrain once from fresh identity after development selection

formal_run.selection_rule: fresh final-32 retrain only after owner-facing focused AS/RL handoff and development selection

checkpointing.retained_state: shared LoRA, optimizer, scheduler, per-rank RNG, deterministic hierarchical sampler cursor, metrics cursor, contract and hashes
